blurb: The Dance Institute of Washington offers dance training for all ages and skill levels, including a pre-professional school and adult classes. They provide rental spaces including a black box theater and dance studios for performances, rehearsals, workshops, and events. The organization supports underserved communities with scholarships and holistic services.
